description.en: Dynamic submucosal injection delivering a lifting cushion of appropriate solution to facilitate snare capture, with safe avoidance of injection through lesions suspected of containing submucosal invasive cancer.

criteria.en: Achieves a partial lift; needle position frequently incorrect.
Consistent dynamic lift; tangential approach; recognises non-lifting sign; avoids injection through suspected SMI.
Teaches the technique; manages the non-lifting lesion; chooses injection solution by clinical context.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE EMR recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The recommendation is what ESGE publishes; the competency is what Evideris uses to score a trainee on. Not enumerated as objects in Tate EMR 2023; this competency frame is Evideris's design.
